name: Command
description:
You speak a one-word command to a creature within medium range. Roll Persuade vs Riddle. On a win, the creature must obey your command on its next turn, unless it doesn’t understand your language or if your command is directly harmful to it.

Some typical commands and their effects:

  • Approach. The target moves toward you by the shortest and most direct route, ending its turn if it becomes adjacent to you.

  • Drop. The target drops whatever it is holding and then ends its turn.

  • Flee. The target spends its turn moving away from you by the fastest available means.

  • Grovel. The target falls prone and then ends its turn.

  • Halt. The target doesn’t move and takes no actions.

You might issue a command other than one described here. If you do so, the GM determines how the target behaves. If the target can’t follow your command, the spell ends.

Describe how you issue the command.
successes:
✨: You may issue a second one-word command that does not contradict your first command. On a win, the creature must also obey that command on its next turn.

🌞: The creature must obey the command(s) on its next 2 turns.
